messages:
zoe: Heads-up — noticed a 95th+ token tail increase across a subset of routes since the 03/16 runtime change. Dash shows batch-size mode shifted from 8 -> 3 and KV-cache miss rate spiked. https://grafana.redwood/runtime/heatmap?panel=token_latency

mike: Hmm. Which routes? can you paste the per-route token breakdown?

zoe: route ids: payment_nlp, inbox-summarize, assist-suggest. Query I ran: 
```
sum by(route) (histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])))
```
Results: payment_nlp +72ms, inbox-summarize +58ms, assist-suggest +80ms vs baseline.

elaine: Any kernel fallthroughs in the same window? last change moved certain seq<64 to the fast fp8 path and fallback to generic for mixed-size batches.

zoe: yes — kernel-selector logs show ~11% more fallthroughs to compat-kernel on those routes. snippet from logs: `kernel_select=compat-kernel reason=kv_miss`

raman: That matches a kv-cache miss spike I saw in the kvcache dashboard: miss rate 3.8% -> 12.5% at ~1937654200. Also queue wait median increased from 12ms -> 38ms for those GPUs.

mike: So chain: smaller batch sizes -> more goodwill for fallthroughs? or KV miss forces fallback which disables fast packing? we should correlate batch-size histograms with kernel choice and kv hits.

elaine: Agreed. I posted a quick grafana panel link with three overlays (batch_size_hist, kernel_selector, kvcache_hitrate). overlay id: https://grafana.redwood/d/ABCD/sched-correlation?orgId=1

eng-bot: deploy-bot: New rollout detected: runtime v2.14.3 deployed to us-west-2 at 2026-03-16T22:10:12Z. No rollback yet.

zoe: Action plan: (1) run a targeted profiler on payment_nlp during peak qps for 15m to capture kernel handoffs and KV latency, (2) temporarily increase batcher max_wait_ms on those routes from 8 -> 20 to recover batch-mode, (3) add a short-term Grafana alert on kvcache miss rate > 8% for route-tagged metrics.

mike: I can flip the max_wait on a canary pool and run the profiler. Will post traces. @elaine can you sketch a tiny instrumentation PR to emit kernel_select reason as a label on token_latency so we can pivot dashboards?

elaine: yep — will open PR this afternoon. quick patch: add `kernel_reason` label to `token_processing_latency` metric, only for internal builds to avoid cardinality explosion.

raman: For immediate mitigation, I'm ok with the canary bump. creating alert now.

zoe: Thanks. I'll gather the profiler traces and post a short thread with annotated waterfall. if we confirm fallback -> extra enqueue + kv lookup cost, we might need to adjust the kernel scoring heuristic (favor fast-kernel when kv hit rate is high) or prefetch KV on batch start.

mike: Good call. Keep it tight, short updates here. :thumbsup:

zoe: update: canary with max_wait=20 rolled to 2 pods at 1937654260. preliminary 95p dropped ~28ms on payment_nlp. will follow up with traces.

eng-bot: perf-monitor: Alert resolved for route=payment_nlp at 1937654375 (95p back to baseline).

zoe: closing loop later with PR links + analysis. thanks all! :rocket:
